description: Header file defining the class 'sta_wlan_hal_dwpal' which provides a hardware abstraction layer for WLAN Station/Client operations, including connection management, scanning, event processing, and network configuration.

classes.name: sta_wlan_hal_dwpal
classes.description: Class implementing WLAN station/client hardware abstraction layer for DWPAL platform, managing connection, scanning, event processing, and network configuration.

methods.name: sta_wlan_hal_dwpal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WLAN station/client interface with interface name, callback, and configuration.

methods.name: scan_bss
methods.description: Scans for a specific BSS given its BSSID, channel, and frequency type.

methods.name: get_scan_results
methods.description: Retrieves scan results for a given SSID.

methods.description: Connects to a network with specified SSID, passphrase, security, BSSID, channel, and hidden SSID flag.

methods.name: roam
methods.description: Roams to a specified BSSID and channel.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if connected to a network.
